notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 51 or higher.
description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Spike Feeder.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to Spike Feeder.
Spike Feeder triggers, putting fifty +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability 25 times by removing 25 +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat.
